 Oct 24, 2026 
 13 hrs ago

 Dear Editor: From American Bridge: Research Books: “Tom Tiffany voted for the Senate FY 2025 budget reconciliation bill, the “One Big Beautiful Bill,” which extended $4 trillion in expiring tax cuts, added new tax breaks, appropriated $448 billion in defense, border, and immigration enforcement funding, increased the SALT deduction To $40,000, and cut Medicaid and other social programs to offset the costs.”
 One of those social programs was SNAP benefits. By direction of that same bill, in November 2027 each state will be required to make up a significant portion of SNAP benefits that were cut in this bill.
 If you support Tom Tiffany for governor, you might want to ask him how he plans to offset that additional cost for Wisconsin in order to maintain the current level of SNAP benefits, which he voted to cut last November.
 Jeff Virchow 
 Prairie du Sac
